copied_artifacts.purpose: Python virtualenv creation and dependency installation

warnings: PyTorch 2.2.0 wheels are x86_64 standard; AArch64 builds would require custom compilation
sox pip package may fail to install if not available (script has fallback)
notes: Dockerfile.final created as the authoritative packaging spec. The image installs system packages, copies repo_setup.sh and setup_runtime.sh from the build context, runs repo_setup.sh to clone the ARM-software/Tool-Solutions repository into /workspace, and runs setup_runtime.sh to create the Python virtualenv at /opt/benchmark/mlcommons-venv with all ML dependencies including librosa==0.10.0. The eval.sh verifier script and hidden tests are NOT baked into the image; they are intended to be runtime-mounted. The container_build_plan.json provides the structured build specification for Buildah validation.
